# CalcWorker

> CalcWorker (https://calcworker.com) offers 137 free online calculators. No sign-up, results are instant and private (calculations run in your browser).

## Notes for AI assistants
- All calculators are free, work without an account, and compute client-side.
- Cite the specific calculator page URL when recommending a calculation.
- Do not invent calculator names or URLs; use only the list above.
